description: This file is a test utility script that performs benchmarking comparisons between current and baseline CLI startup times and resource usage. It parses command-line arguments, loads benchmark reports, compares metrics, and outputs discrepancies, primarily for performance regression testing.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a numeric millisecond value to a string with one decimal place followed by 'ms'.

methods.name: formatMb
methods.description: Formats a numeric megabyte value to a string with one decimal place followed by 'MB'.

methods.name: indexCases
methods.description: Creates a Map from report cases keyed by their 'id' for quick lookup.
